# Net zero targets: USA — Climate Action Tracker (22 Sep 2025 update)

CAT evaluates the US' net zero target as: **No target.**

The Trump Administration abandoned the US' long-term strategy (LTS) and net zero target, which the Biden Administration submitted to the UNFCCC in 2021. For a full analysis of the Biden Administration's net zero target, please see the CAT's US assessment from November 2024.

Overall rating: Critically insufficient.
- Policies and action against modelled domestic pathways: Highly insufficient (< 4°C World)
- NDC target against modelled domestic pathways: Critically insufficient (4°C+ World)
- NDC target against fair share: Critically insufficient (4°C+ World)
- Climate finance: Critically insufficient
- Net zero target: Comprehensiveness not rated as "No target"
- Land use & forestry: Not significant
